description: Text to speech (TTS): convert text to natural spoken MP3 audio with Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, returned as base64. Use it for voice replies, narration, audio versions of text and accessibility. Input: text; optional voice name. $0.25 per call. Returns: text_chars, voice, audio_base64, mime_type.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_speech_synthesize
title: Text to speech
